pr_title: executor, privilege: fix privilege validation on information_shema.columns, explain and desc
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: Zijie Lu <wslzj40@gmail.com>

<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #28675

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?
In MySQL8.0, only a user who have at least one of `insert`, `select`, `update` and `references` can select the `information_schema.columns`. `explain` and `desc` also need the privilege mentioned before. So we need to check if at least one of these privileges have been granted.

issue_context.title: `information_schema.columns`, `explain` and `desc` should not get results with the `SHOW VIEW` privilege
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

It is found by https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/28662 and the test `TestShowViewPriv` skips it for now.

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

```sql
MySQL -h127.1 -uroot
mysql> create user test_user;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.04 sec)

mysql> create view db.v as select 1;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.04 sec)

mysql> grant show view on db.v to test_user;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

MySQL -h127.1 -utest_user
mysql> select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema='db' and table_name='v';
+----------+
| count(*) |
+----------+
|        1 |
+----------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> explain db.v;
+-------+-----------+------+------+---------+-------+
| Field | Type      | Null | Key  | Default | Extra |
+-------+-----------+------+------+---------+-------+
| 1     | bigint(1) | NO   |      | NULL    |       |
+-------+-----------+------+------+---------+-------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> desc db.v;
+-------+-----------+------+------+---------+-------+
| Field | Type      | Null | Key  | Default | Extra |
+-------+-----------+------+------+---------+-------+
| 1     | bigint(1) | NO   |      | NULL    |       |
+-------+-----------+------+------+---------+-------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

In MySQL 8.0:
```sql
mysql> select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema='db' and table_name='v';
+----------+
| count(*) |
+----------+
|        0 |
+----------+
1 row in set (0.04 sec)

mysql> explain db.v;
Empty set (0.01 sec)

mysql> desc db.v;
Empty set (0.00 sec)
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

```sql
mysql> select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema='db' and table_name='v';
+----------+
| count(*) |
+----------+
|        1 |
+----------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> explain db.v;
+-------+-----------+------+------+---------+-------+
| Field | Type      | Null | Key  | Default | Extra |
+-------+-----------+------+------+---------+-------+
| 1     | bigint(1) | NO   |      | NULL    |       |
+-------+-----------+------+------+---------+-------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> desc db.v;
+-------+-----------+------+------+---------+-------+
| Field | Type      | Null | Key  | Default | Extra |
+-------+-----------+------+------+---------+-------+
| 1     | bigint(1) | NO   |      | NULL    |       |
+-------+-----------+------+------+---------+-------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

master.

review_comments: You could simplify this by only adding the `mysql.AllColumnsPrivs` to `priv` in the loop and then call `checker.RequestVerification(..., priv)` after the loop.

But if we simplify by doing that, `priv` will be `mysql.AllColumnsPrivs`, and we don't know what privileges the user actually has, and need another `checker.RequestVerification` to verify it. So maybe we don't need to simplify it?

If we use `mysql.AllColumnPrivs` here, we also need to iterate over `mysql.AllColumnPrivs`. It seems that we can keep using `!checker.RequestVerification(activeRoles, e.DBName.O, tb.Meta().Name.O, "", mysql.InsertPriv|mysql.SelectPriv|mysql.UpdatePriv|mysql.ReferencesPriv)`
